sample_scope: 100 unique training patients; at least 20 positives per target; metadata-only purposive sample, not prevalence representative

pilot_scaler.scope: PILOT-ONLY statistics from the selected training sample; not parameters for a full training run

decoder_scope: Narrow single-file multiplexed WFDB format 16 only, following official format specification; no general WFDB library cross-check
limitations: Purposive sample is not representative of whole-dataset signal quality or class prevalence.
Passing checks does not establish medical correctness of annotations or diagnostic adequacy of 100 Hz.
Final normalization must be fitted to the complete eligible training cohort; pilot parameters must not be reused as final parameters.
Unsupported WFDB encodings are rejected; adopt and cross-check a standard reader before a general data pipeline.
